metadata.title: Urban Portrait with High-Contrast Serif Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, low-angle urban portrait of a man in a white t-shirt against a red brick wall, dominated by oversized, bright red serif typography that spans the top edge and overlaps the subject's head.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant red of the typography echoes the muted red tones of the brick background.
The stark white t-shirt provides a central high-value anchor against the darker skin tones and brick textures.
The oversized text creates a physical weight that seems to press down on the subject's head.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Visible film grain and analog photographic texture
Oversized serif typography bleeding off the top and side edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject slightly hunched, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white t-shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the aggressive red typography at the top, moves down to the subject's downward-looking gaze, and settles on the contrast of the white shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with the subject, the wall, and the large-scale text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text creates a flat, graphic layer over a desaturated, textured photographic base.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thin hairlines and thick stems
Large x-height with tight letter spacing
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard glyphs used at extreme scale
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact; secondary metadata in a small, boxed sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Rectangular informational badge in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic high-contrast serif look with sharp terminals.
Offers a similar traditional but aggressive serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, low-angle portrait of a man with braided hair wearing a plain white t-shirt, standing in front of a weathered red brick wall. The lighting is natural but slightly moody, with a film-like texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a single word in all-caps across the very top of the frame in a bright red, high-contrast serif font. The letters should be large enough to touch the top edge and overlap the man's head. Add a small black and white rectangular advisory badge in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the red text the most saturated element?
Does the text overlap the subject's head?
Is the background a textured brick wall?
Is the overall image quality grainy and film-like?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is flat and lacks digital effects like bevel or glow.
Check that the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Verify the white t-shirt is the brightest part of the photographic layer.
Confirm the typography bleeds off the top edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + High-Contrast Serif Overlay + Red/White/Brick Palette
